description: Writes the generated dispatch registry for each source collection in functions/dispatch-sources.json (issue #2451): functions/src/<area>/dispatch/<source>.generated.ts imports every export const <name> = defineProjections("<source>", [...]) set in functions/src and passes them to dispatchTrigger (functions/src/platform/dispatch/runtime.ts), the one Firestore trigger for that collection. --check fails when a registry is missing, stale or orphaned, when a set names an unlisted source or calls defineProjections any other way, and when the area's functions.ts does not re-export the dispatcher. audit:functions-contexts runs the same check as part of the Functions lane gate.
